Start at [project intent](intent/README.md); it routes by the task and names the
binding context. [Vision](../VISION.md) defines exceptional experiences and cumulative
reuse; [scope](intent/scope.md) distinguishes shipped capability from accepted design.

Earlier design documents contain planned APIs and dated dependency research.
ADR-0020 governs the shared catalog/Gallery; ADR-0021 governs runtime profiles.
Do not infer implementation or support from a type sketch, screenshot or package name.
Each fact has one home; link to it instead of expanding always-loaded agent context.
